edges.reason: msg.sender is only compared to owner inside a discarded comma expression, so any caller can whitelist itself.
changeOwner is guarded by require(msg.sender==owner).
updateContracts is guarded by require(msg.sender==owner).
freePusher requires Init.friendlyaddress(msg.sender), but the whitelist itself is settable by anyone.
freePopper is gated only by the friendly address whitelist.
newOrder is gated only by the friendly address whitelist.
changeAdmin checks ETMOWNER_ROLE of _msgSender() before granting all admin roles.
mint checks MINTER_ROLE of _msgSender().
orderExpired can be triggered by anyone as soon as matchOrderMap.expiryDate <= now (timestamp dependency).
dueCheck requires now >= time + duesPaid*30 days, making execution time dependent.
payDue compares duesPaid against (now - matchOrderMap.time)/30 days.
calculateECOEarning accrues rewards from (now - time), a miner influenced timestamp.
scheduleExpiry forwards value plus fee to abacus.scheduleFunc.
Abacus later calls back into orderExpired on this contract, releasing collateral with no reentrancy guard.
WithdrawManager sends native ETH to a caller controlled recipient address.
DepositManager calls transferFrom/approve on a caller supplied token address.
sendValue performs a low level call forwarding all gas to an arbitrary recipient.
dues accrual and record subtraction use raw operators on user controlled amounts in Solidity 0.6.12.
setFriendlyAddress never enforces the owner comparison, so msg.sender can self whitelist.
usdvalue*1e16 and the time based multiplication can overflow without SafeMath.
poolSorter writes into temp, a memory array that was never allocated.
initialize assigns the owner state variable.
Deposit pushes the record through EDM.freePusher.
Deposit forwards funds through EMM.DepositManager.
Deposit mints the wrapped token through EMM.mintWrappedToken.
Withdraw routes the mixed balance case into internal _withdraw.
Withdraw pays out through EMM.WithdrawManager.
availableBalance is derived from wrapped balance minus deposits and borrows.
_withdraw calls EDM.freePopper to settle the user deposit records.
Borrow withdraws the real token through EMM.WithdrawManager.
clearBorrow repays through EMM.DepositManager.
matchOrder schedules the expiry callback through scheduleExpiry.
matchOrder writes the matched order record.
matchOrder deletes the consumed pending order.
dueCheck expires the order when dues remain unpaid.
dueCheck toggles isUserLocked through Init.setUserLocked.
orderExpired sets the order status to CLOSED.
newOrder updates user deposit or borrow totals before matching.
tID is read from the token order pool inside newOrder.
freePusher appends to the user storage arrays and totals.
freePopper mutates and pops user storage entries.
poolSorter rewrites the sorted order pool.
poolSorter recomputes the cached poolindex boundary.
changeOwner writes the owner state variable.
updateContracts re-points EMM, abacus and EDM from the Init config.
setFriendlyAddress writes the global permission whitelist.
setOwnerFeeVault credits the protocol fee vault.
_transfer mutates sender and recipient balances.
_transfer enforces the availableAmount rule against lockedAmount.
mint increases the total wrapped supply.
changeAdmin grants DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER and PAUSER roles without removing the old admin.
adjustEcoEarning subtracts from ecoWithdrawls with no underflow protection.
w2wswap performs mint, lock, release and burn through the wTokens registry.
isWithdrawEligible consults registrar status to bypass collateral limits.

normalization_plan.reason: userAddress is only a storage index for the core freePopper routine.
_amount is only the value written by the core freePusher routine.
_tokenSymbol only selects the order pool inside newOrder.
rtoken only selects the transfer branch inside Deposit.
_duration only parameterises the order created by newOrder.
_yield only parameterises sorting and matching in newOrder.
_orderId only indexes the matched order released by orderExpired.
msgSender is a cached copy of msg.sender inside Withdraw.
wtoken is a derived symbol consumed by the Deposit flow.
_usdValue is a derived value stored by freePusher.
amountLeft is a loop variable of freePopper.
dues is the return accumulator of freePopper.
availableBalance is a computed branch selector in Withdraw.
newStorage is the struct pushed by freePusher.
tID is a pool lookup value used only by newOrder.
temp is the scratch array manipulated by poolSorter.
data is the callback payload built by scheduleExpiry.
callCost is the payable amount built by scheduleExpiry.
